apps.name: GrandStand
apps.subtitle: Live sport, TV, movies and replays
apps.localizedDescription: Live sport from every source in one place, free-to-air and sports channels, Twitch, full-game replays, and movies and TV shows (with a TorBox account).

versions.localizedDescription: Boxing & UFC replays now offer proper HD copies through TorBox (e.g. DAZN 720p/1080p), ahead of the ok.ru ones. New MotoGP replays tab. Sections of the app can now be hidden per access group.
Finished StreamFree events (like a UFC card hours after it ended) no longer show as live.
